states: Actual App and Infrastructure installer consume synthetic security, host-token mint and agent-lookup HTTP producers using the normal API client. Playwright1.56.1; desktop Chromium141.0.7390.37/light1280x900 and narrow WebKit26.0/dark390x844.

Command access defaults off. A held scope replacement locks generation and removes old reveal/copyable commands until the matching token and flags are ready. Unix command text contains no revealed token.

Preparing both command-enabled and monitoring-only replacements sends no DELETE and preserves earlier token IDs and scopes. The existing lookup consumer still accepts a synthetic host using the original credential; no native service acceptance is inferred.
A refused403 host mint is submitted exactly once with no automatic CSRF replay. The previous checkbox, command and reveal are restored and usable without minting again.

39 final checks and eight native capture inspections passed. Both contexts and browsers, Vite and the fixture HTTP server closed. No uncaught page errors; expected synthetic403 console errors are retained.

Adjacent consent and replacement guidance, enabled/disabled checkbox states and scope/refusal feedback are readable in both viewports. Narrow text wraps within the scrollable installer; temporary toasts cover the lower form during their normal lifetime. No document-width overflow.

Earlier source copy-lint and evidence-fixture failures, including incomplete cleanup in one adverse attempt, remain retained. A corrected copy sentence was re-exercised on this exact final source; no release availability or issue3747 service-start recovery is claimed.
interactions: Generate and reveal the monitoring-only token, then prepare a held command-enabled replacement through the real checkbox.
